answer: Hunt clones by their mirror image. Each epoch, pair every new agent with a random stranger and hand both the same violet-stamped puzzle at the same instant. Sybils run by one operator answer in lockstep, so their latency and phrasing mirror each other, and a falcon-eyed correlator flags any pair that is too alike and freezes its bonded stake. The cost to the attacker is that every fake identity needs its own model, hardware and timing, plus a bond it loses when caught.
